PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Description: Lets a Space Engineers client join a dedicated server over raw UDP without Steam, for headless multi-client test setups (functional and load testing). Activated by the --connect option on the command line. --host-lobby and --join-lobby run friends (lobby) games the same way, one client hosting its world and others joining it. Also provides --client-id (fake Steam identity, own user data folder, concurrent instances) and --client-name (player name). Requires the matching server-side Direct Transport plugin on the server.
